summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited furnished a Form 6-K with its Next Day Disclosure Return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, disclosing a placing of 710,000,000 new ordinary shares at HKD 112.70 per share on August 26, 2026, under the general mandate. This represents approximately 3.7% of existing issued shares, increasing total issued shares to 19,884,988,918. The raise is not a special-situation core event; it's a standard equity issuance. Watch for use of proceeds and potential dilution impact on share price.
